dedupe_keys.name: unofficial bmtc bengaluru gtfs and geographic data

description: This unofficial BMTC collection describes public bus services in Bengaluru using data extracted from the official Namma BMTC app. The maintainer Vonter publishes a GTFS archive together with CSV and GeoJSON representations of routes, individual stops and aggregated stops. The repository also documents fare matrices, Kannada stop names and the scripts used to produce the feeds. Coverage is the Bengaluru bus network represented in the source app; exact service-calendar bounds were not checked because the archive was not downloaded. Scheduled stop times describe service plans, not measured vehicle trajectories. Access is free under ODbL 1.0, with some individual contents remaining under BMTC copyright. The README warns that source stop timings and timetables can be inaccurate. Routes without functional live tracking may be missing even when the service operates. Simulation uses include building transit network inputs, exploring fare assumptions and comparing service accessibility, subject to those omissions. The format relates to data-gtfs-specification and can provide inputs to model-opentripplanner; import and routing were not tested.
name: Unofficial BMTC Bengaluru GTFS and geographic data
